source: Verified original current 37.0 client; selections are integration guidance, with original full data preserved unchanged.
transform_guidance: Set top root translation to zero before placing instance; minion/hand/power roots contain editor scene positions. Preserve original root scale (hero 1.11, power 0.95) unless intentionally changing gameplay sizing.
Preserve every ancestor and child local transform. Hand minion/spell Mesh children rotate 180 degrees about Y. Models lie primarily in local XZ with positive Y front.

Geometry JSON preserves original Unity vertices, normals and winding. UnityPy OBJ instead reflects X and reverses triangle winding. Apply one consistent Unity-to-engine transform and winding convention.
Exported PNGs have ordinary top-left image orientation. Unity UV origin is bottom-left. Whether to flip V depends on the renderer/importer convention; avoid double-flipping.

runtime_overrides.portraits: Use actor_bindings m_portraitMesh plus m_portraitMatIdx. Bind actual official portrait art. Never omit entire PortraitFrame_mesh because it also contains frame geometry.
runtime_overrides.text: CurvedText MeshRenderers have null material and require runtime text generation. Replace them or populate labels at the UberText anchor transforms. Original UberText configuration is included.
runtime_overrides.special_decorations: Do not blindly render every active serialized child. Disable legendary dragons for ordinary cards; class rune banners for neutral/non-DeathKnight cards; ghost/highlight FX; BG/faction/multiclass decorations; graveyard cracks; rarity and tribe plates according to card data.
